objective: Complete Smart Drawer R2 note reliability and consent-based cluster/individual mini-workspaces with protected auto-expiry, local folders, file import, explicit reminders and project permissions, without new native dependencies.

acceptanceChecks: All modified files belong to the explicitly authorized Smart Drawer R2 workstream and do not replace previous features
Natural-language due and expiry dates do not invent reminders or misfile plain prose as checklists
Unlimited-length note bodies remain intact; imported documents retain their original local files and are not shared implicitly
Existing local SQLite notes migrate without loss; user-scoped folders can be created, renamed, browsed, removed and notes safely unfiled
Only explicitly expiring unprotected content is automatically moved to recoverable trash; important and pinned content is never auto-purged
Shared project RLS limits reading to owner, invited individuals or active scope members and limits editing to owner or explicitly invited editors
Only owners can grant/revoke or delete shared copies, alter expiration protection or create project folders; revision conflicts are rejected
Shared reminders use bounded due batches with unique idempotency claims and the existing notification dispatch trigger, without cluster-wide fan-out
Google Calendar export is an optional one-way user-confirmed link; private local originals have no claimed automatic cloud backup
No new native modules or v29 APK; migration must be verified before RC, and production OTA needs immutable runtime and artifact gates
